ModMetaData.name: Rim-pilot
ModMetaData.author: Rim-pilot contributors
ModMetaData.description: Local authenticated observation bridge under development. Health, capabilities and read-only observation routes (summary, colonists, things, resources, UI, public events, screenshots); coverage is partial and not fully verified in the real game. Things and resources refuse as unavailable whenever the map's raw spawned-thing list is over 2,048 members (every real map tried) even though capabilities reports them available; treat a refusal as unknown, never as empty. No gameplay or UI input routes. Requires separately installed Harmony. Enable manually and restart; no settings or mod-order edits are performed by the bridge.
